children: New Delhi, Sept. 3 -- Hexaware Technologies share price fell as much as 4% on NSE in Thursday's trading session after the company announced the resignation of CEO Srikrishna Ramakarthikeyan.
The stock opened at Rs.538 per share on NSE today, as compared to previous close of Rs.543.60 on Wednesday.
